title: Grill Stable Failure Classification
description: Failure classes that propagate through the grill-system and downstream skills. Each class has a severity and a propagation status that never maps to completed.

classes.name: session-id-missing
classes.description: The grill session has no formal session identifier.

classes.name: missing-required-question-field
classes.description: A grill question is missing a required field (id, question, purpose, recommendedAnswer, blockingDecision, status, or severity).

classes.name: multiple-questions-in-one
classes.description: A single grill question item contains more than one question.

classes.name: invalid-question-status
classes.description: A question status is not one of the allowed values.

classes.name: invalid-question-severity
classes.description: A question severity is not P0, P1, or P2.

classes.name: invalid-session-status
classes.description: The session status is not draft, blocked, complete, or risk-accepted.

classes.name: complete-with-p0-open-items
classes.description: The session claims complete while P0 open items remain unresolved.

classes.name: missing-recommended-answer
classes.description: A question has no recommended answer.

classes.name: no-questions-in-non-template
classes.description: A non-template report contains zero questions.

classes.name: sensitive-data-in-report
classes.description: The report contains a secret-like or credential-like value.

classes.name: parse-error
classes.description: The report could not be parsed or the grill-session block was not found.

classes.name: missing-top-level-fields
classes.description: Required top-level fields are missing from the session.
